slides.texte_overlay:
detachment lessons that
shifted my entire mindset

not everything needs a reply

i stopped answering every comment, message and argument right away. most things that feel urgent stop mattering after an hour, and my peace stayed intact.

people can misunderstand me

i accepted that some people will get me wrong, no matter what i do. explaining myself over and over only drained my energy, and it rarely changed anyone's mind at all.

outcomes aren't mine to control

i do my best work and then let go of how it's received. caring about the effort instead of the result made me so much braver and far less anxious every day.

my mind needs better inputs

i replaced 5 minutes of scrolling a day with learning something real: a painting, a planet, a moment in history. feeding my mind better made letting go much easier.

i replaced 5 minutes of scrolling a day with one lesson in the Sophia app: a painting, a planet, a moment in history. feeding my mind better made letting go so much easier.

slides.texte_overlay:
silence is an answer

i learned that not reacting is sometimes the strongest response. walking away calmly from drama says far more about you than any clever reply ever could.
